title: The Clean Paintbrushes

moral: Finishing together matters more than finishing first.
summary: At a garden row with string and two watering cans, a paintbrushes rinsed while someone read the color names will go wrong if one person rushes. Yael and Wynn split it into two slow jobs, while Miss Dalca only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
